notes.title: Autumn Nightmare Update
notes.notes:
New update of Selma and the Wisp is already available! We prepared for you a bunch of new features so get ready to play and explore an eerie land with Selma and the Wisp.

An update includes:
Steam cloud integration
13 new languages available
Upgraded artificial intelligence of Selma
New achievements
New secret locations in the game
Nightmare mode 
Minor bugs fixed

Follow the wisp. Collect the lights. Don’t look back.

notes.title: Update + Linux + Mac OS X
notes.notes:
New update is here. We added intro and now Selma and the Wisp is available also on Linux and Mac OS X.

General

Intro added
Better Selma movement
Better switching gamepad to mouse
Changed default graphics settings from very low to high.
Linux version.
Mac version.


Levels
Level 1
Removed crawling under the bridge.
Level 2
Fixed camera zoom on mill.
Level 3
Fixed going up the platforms over the trap with rising waters.
Level 4
Added laser sound and changed shooting frequency.
Level 5
Fixed conveyors placement.
Level 6
Crows more often attack and cross the cables.
Plasma in restaurant does more damage.
Level 7
Fixed bug with wisp flying through the floor.
Level 8
Selma can walk across all fountain.
Fixed movement over the cars.
Level 9
Fixed falling rocks.
Fixed bug with wisp flying through balloon.
